blocks.text: All organisms have certain requirements for life. They fulfill the requirements by interacting with other organisms and with the physical environment. Ecology is the study of the relationships of organisms with other organisms and the environment. In this chapter, you would get learning on the basic concepts of environment and the cycling of materials and energy between the environment and organisms.
To understand how life works, we must look through different "levels" on which natural world is organized into layers of increasing complexity.
